name: Galaxy Note 9

images.credit: TheWikiContributor, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Platform.Operating system: Original: Android Oreo 8.1 with Samsung Experience 9.5, Current: Android 10 with One UI 2.5 , Unofficial: Up to Android 15 with One UI 7.0, Noble ROM
Platform.Chipset: Australia, United Kingdom and the rest of the world: Samsung Exynos 9810, North America, China, Hong Kong, Japan and Latin America: Qualcomm Snapdragon 845
Platform.CPU: Exynos: Octa-core (4x2.7 GHz Cortex-A55 & 4x1.7 GHz Mongoose M3), Snapdragon: Octa-core (4x2.8 GHz Kryo 385 Gold & 4x1.7 GHz Kryo 385 Silver)
Platform.GPU: Exynos: Mali (GPU), Mali-G72 MP18, Snapdragon: Adreno 630

Memory.RAM: 6 GB (128 GB model) 8 GB (512 GB model)
Memory.Card slot: microSD card support up to 512 GB

Display.Display: 6.4 inches (162.0 mm) Super AMOLED capacitive touchscreen display, 2960×1440 px resolution (516 ppi)

Cameras.Rear camera: Dual 12 MP (1.4 μm, f/1.5/2.4) + 12 MP ((1.0 μm), f/2.4), Dual OIS, 4K at 30 or 60 fps (limited to 5 min)[1], QHD at 30 fps, 1080p at 30 or 60 fps, 720p at 30 fps and slow motion at 960 fps

Sound.Sound: Stereo speakers tuned by AKG with Dolby Atmos support

Battery.Charging: Wired: Qualcomm Quick Charge 2.0 (15 W), Qi wireless charging at 15 W

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 5 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac (2.4/5 GHz), VHT80, MU-MIMO, 1024-QAM Bluetooth 5.0 (LE up to 2 Mbps), ANT+, USB-C, 3.5 mm headphone jack, NFC, location (GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou)
